newsitem.title: CHINA: Egana says spin-off plan in progress.
newsitem.headline: Egana says spin-off plan in progress.

text.p: Egana International (Holdings) Ltd said on Thursday its group reorganisation and financial review in preparation for a proposed separate listing of its jewellery operations in Hong Kong was progressing.
The company said an investment holding company, Egana Jewellery & Pearls Ltd, had been dully established as the spin-off vehicle.
"The directors are still in discussion with the financial advisor regarding the possible terms and structure of the proposal and no binding agreement relating thereto has been reached," it said.

Egana also said it was exploring opportunities for business expansion in Asia. It said it was in negotiation to place shares to third parties which had interests in China, so as to assist the company's business development in the country.
The company said no binding agreement had yet been arrived.
